summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by SunCar Technology Group Inc., a foreign private issuer, furnishing an earnings release for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The release announces annual revenue of $489 million, profitability in the second half of 2025, and a net loss reduction. It highlights business updates such as a strategic AI partnership with ByteDance and contracts with Tesla, Xiaomi, and NIO. No special-situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, tender offer, restructuring) is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results and operational developments, not a special situation.
